top_stories.title: Attackers Pose as IT Support on Microsoft Teams, Abuse AD CS to Steal Company Data
top_stories.summary: Attackers impersonated IT support staff via Microsoft Teams to gain remote access to employee machines, then exploited misconfigured Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS) to obtain authentication certificates for privileged accounts including domain controllers. Microsoft investigated two such intrusions, with at least one resulting in company data theft.

top_stories.title: mSecure Warns Users to Change Passwords, Reset 2FA and Passkeys After Suspicious Activity
top_stories.summary: mSecure password manager developer mSeven Software issued a warning to users on November 3 urging them to change passwords, reset two-factor authentication, and remove passkeys following detected suspicious activity. The company has not yet disclosed the nature or scope of the incident affecting the credential management application.

top_stories.title: Oh, your agents need OAuth2, too
top_stories.summary: Dan Moore, Senior Director of CIAM Strategy and Identity Standards at FusionAuth, discussed adapting OAuth2 protocols for autonomous AI agents at the LDX3 conference by LeadDev. The conversation focused on the security requirement of assigning distinct identities to AI agents and applying established OAuth2 frameworks to agentic systems.

top_stories.title: Phishing-resistant MFA where it matters most, and finding the privileged identities your role report misses
top_stories.summary: This article is part of a series on implementing phishing-resistant MFA and passkeys in Microsoft Entra ID, with a focus on protecting privileged administrator accounts. The piece covers securing Global Administrator accounts and identifying privileged identities that may be missed in standard role reports.

top_stories.title: Okta Set to Join S&P 500; Others to Join S&P MidCap 400 and S&P SmallCap 600
top_stories.summary: Okta Inc. is set to join the S&P 500 index, moving up from the S&P MidCap 400, effective prior to trading on November 4. This index inclusion reflects Okta's market capitalization growth as a major IAM vendor.

news.title: Fake job interview opened the door to $6.34 billion Binance heist
news.summary: Attackers stole $6.34 billion from Binance by combining social engineering via fake job interviews, malicious software downloads, compromised internal AI tooling, endpoint compromise, and an advanced transaction-authorization bypass. The breach involved initial access gained through a tampered software installer delivered during a fraudulent recruitment process, with North Korea suspected as the threat actor.

news.title: Barracuda Flaws Could Be Chained to Bypass Authorization and Gain Root Access
news.summary: Barracuda has disclosed two vulnerabilities—a pre-authentication authorization bypass (CVE-2026-116606, CVSS 9.3) and a command injection flaw—that can be chained to bypass authorization controls and gain root access on affected devices. The flaws are relevant to IAM due to the authorization bypass component, though the primary concern is broader network security affecting Barracuda appliances.

news.title: Opal’s agent.ID virtual event: Top security leaders on governing Al agents
news.summary: Opal Security will host agent.ID, a free virtual event on November 5, 2026, focused on adapting IAM practices to AI agents. The event will feature CISOs and identity leaders from companies including Elastic, Instacart, Notion, Databricks, and Knostic.

news.title: Amazon Quick on desktop now uses your organization's existing Amazon Quick sign-in
news.summary: Amazon Quick has updated its desktop application to use the same organizational sign-in method already configured for the web version, eliminating the need for a separate OIDC application registration in the identity provider. Administrators no longer need to perform additional identity provider configuration steps to support desktop app authentication.

news.title: Okta to Announce Third Quarter Fiscal Year 2027 Financial Results on December 1, 2026
news.summary: Okta announced it will release its third quarter fiscal year 2027 financial results on December 1, 2026. The results will cover the quarter ended October 31, 2026.

news.title: Chainalysis Confirms Intrusion Into Internal Tools and Exposure of Customer Identity Data
news.summary: Chainalysis, a blockchain analysis firm, confirmed a cybersecurity intrusion in which an external actor accessed non-sensitive customer identity data through internal tools. The company stated that authentication credentials and session tokens were not compromised in the incident.

news.title: Okta jumps after-hours following tapped inclusion in the S&P 500
news.summary: Okta has been selected by S&P Dow Jones Indices to join the S&P 500 benchmark index. The announcement caused Okta shares to climb 2.1% in after-hours trading.

news.title: Implement least-privilege access with designations in Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio
news.summary: Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio has introduced a "designations" feature, which are named permission sets enabling granular, least-privilege access control for project members. The feature allows administrators to define and assign specific permissions to users within SageMaker projects.

news.title: $38.4 bn market cap: DHS Data leak details - Okta says its core systems not compromised | All you need about company
news.summary: A data leak allegedly exposing personal and job details of over 40,000 Department of Homeland Security employees is under investigation, with Distributed Denial of Secrets claiming the data came through Okta. Okta has responded stating it found no evidence that its core systems or infrastructure were compromised.

news.title: Hackers steal and publish data on 41,000 Homeland Security workers
news.summary: A hacker group claims to have stolen and published data on 41,000 Department of Homeland Security employees. The exposed data includes work contact details and internal group memberships, raising concerns about identity exposure and directory enumeration.

news.title: Hackers leak personnel data of 41,000+ Homeland Security staff, including ICE and border agents
news.summary: Hackers leaked personal data of over 41,000 Department of Homeland Security employees, including ICE and CBP agents. The breach exposed personnel records of federal security staff and was published online.
